newsitem.title: UK: Britannic new 1996 regular premiums rise.
newsitem.headline: Britannic new 1996 regular premiums rise.

text.p: Insurance group Britannic Assurance Plc said on Thursday that total new regular premiums rose 7.7 percent to 37.06 million stg and single premiums increased 16.8 percent to 137 million stg in 1996.
Britannic chief executive Brian Shaw described the performance as "very satisfactory", with sound contributions from all areas of the business.
"Britannic is a major force in the home service sector and we believe these results will increase our share of this highly competitive market," said Shaw.

"Through the introduction of new technology, continuing product development and a strong commitment to reducing costs, we look forward to building on last year's performance and improving value to customers."
